title: Design the first reversible local-storage port seam
purpose: Map every current player persistence access and accept one minimal reversible seam that extracts the existing synchronous localStorage adapter into a dedicated runtime source owner without changing storage technology, keys, data shapes, identifiers, UI or behavior.
invariants: This work package changes design and governance records only; no player source or artifact is modified.
The accepted seam retains localStorage as the synchronous backend and retains the existing memory fallback.
IndexedDB durable snapshot ownership remains unchanged and outside the first seam.
Every current storage key, database name, store name, record id, data shape and identifier remains unchanged.
The lexical storage API and all existing callers remain unchanged during Stage C.
No learner-facing UI, behavior, import, activity, progression, bilan or recommendation changes are authorized.
Stage D remains blocked until a separate Stage C implementation and governor acceptance are merged.
requiredEvidence: runtime storage primitive cartography on the exact base commit
complete frozen key and durable database inventory
minimal port contract with existing failure semantics
machine-checkable disjoint developer, QA, integrator and governor scopes
static and black-box equivalence test plan
Repository governance and PR scope passes on the exact design head
adversarialTests: search all player runtime sources for direct window.localStorage and indexedDB access
verify the seam does not change a key, schema, identifier or browser storage primitive
verify developer and QA write scopes are disjoint
verify the design excludes every held platform domain
verify rollback requires no data migration or compensating action
verify the design does not treat target architecture as current implementation
nonGoals: replace the existing durable snapshot store
introduce repositories, dependency injection or asynchronous storage semantics
change canonical identifiers or content contracts
add backend, accounts, synchronization, catalog, commerce, institutions or marketplace
start the Stage D controlled multi-AI pilot
independentReview: future adversarial QA and integrator review remain separately required for Stage C

result.acceptedSeam: extract the unchanged synchronous storage adapter from runtime part 00 into new runtime part 04
result.implementationCondition: Create and accept a separate Stage C work package from the exact post-merge main commit before any player file changes.

rollback: Revert the design pull request. No application source, artifact, key, browser storage, learner data or remote system is changed by this design record.
